source-release-verify.description: T-554 bounded post-release verification: fixed LedgerWash v0.5.0 source 85cf8e6f99fcc576240cb6783b65b98a3341dfb1 and tag CI 39048676325 attempt 1. Independently read public release/tag/run/jobs/artifacts metadata; require nine successful tag jobs. Fetch the exact public Git commit and both user-facing source ZIP/tar.gz downloads; bounded parsers reject unsafe paths, links, duplicates, unexpected files and excessive sizes; compare every file to its Git blob without normalization. Build wheel/sdist only from verified source using pinned uv/build constraints, verify package payload/metadata/RECORD and sdist source, install the non-editable wheel into a fresh venv and run the original 154-test suite and qualify outside the source checkout with hash-pinned pytest dependencies. Preserve frozen-baseline controls, all original bytes, commands, raw metadata, manifests, distributions, JUnit and failures in private EC receipts. Network only public GitHub source/metadata and PyPI dependencies; no credentials, models, subject code execution, host/profile/App/POLICY changes, publishing or deployment. No free parameters or mutable source selection.

Preserve commands, raw metadata, original ZIPs, JUnit, outputs, hashes and every failure in EC private receipts. GitHub-hosted producers plus EC Windows verification is not all-platform EC execution or ledger authenticity.
